Mr. Richard H. Golterman Under Secretary Chief Transportation Engineer Attention: Bureau of Planning Administration Building 2300 South 31st Street Springfield, Illinois 62706
Dear Mr. Golterman:
As required by the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, the Governor's Office of Human Resources has reviewed the attached listing of projects and has found that those projects will precipitate no major displacement of urban housing nor have any significant impact upon lower income neighborhoods; consequently, this office finds no adverse environmental effects relative to its particular areas of expertise and interest.
Carolyn A. Kruse Acting Ass't. Administrative
